about.hero_body: Book Studio is a full-stack Laravel app for authoring, organizing, and publishing books — currently a solo project, built and extended feature by feature.
about.project_body: Under the hood, Book Studio pairs session and token auth side by side, OTP email verification, Google sign-in, role-based admin tooling, PDF export with multiple layout templates, and OCR-assisted content import — all wrapped in full English/Arabic/French localization with RTL support.
about.roadmap_body: This project is still growing — new features are added regularly. This section will fill in as they land.
about.cta_body: Bug reports and feature suggestions are always welcome.
